frigate.notes: Techage on the Xiongmai/XMEye (XMeye Pro / iCSee) OEM platform; RTSP path is firmware-dependent and UNVERIFIED. Legacy Xiongmai form shown; newer firmware may use /live/main and /live/sub. Confirm via ONVIF discovery.

home_assistant.notes: Use the ONVIF integration (Xiongmai/XMEye OEM, default port 80). XMEye/iCSee cloud is proprietary; ONVIF/RTSP is the local path.
